messages:
julia (Sales Ops): Daily async — Velux Labs pilot.

What I did: signed SOW + sent onboarding packet to devs.
Blockers: Velux security wants BYOK/HSM attestation and network diagram before legal signs off. Need expected lead time.
Today: coordinate with @miho for attestation checklist, ask @oliver for arch diagram, try to lock PO date.

james (AE): Quick add — devs reported higher initial qps need (est 20k/day). Can we confirm dedicated ramps or burst policy? :thinking: 

miho (Security): I can do attestation checklist. Short list: HSM vendor attestation, KMS key policy, network ACLs, data residency. Upload answers to shared drive.
Also we can offer two options: 1) customer BYOK with HSM + onprem key auth; 2) managed KMS with customer-managed keys in partner KMS (faster). Which does Velux prefer?

miho (Security): KMS sample policy (can paste to Velux)
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodKeyAdmin"},"Action":"kms:*","Resource":"*"}]
}
```

oliver (Solutions): I’ll prep a 1-pager arch diagram and a quick demo of VPC/private option. ETA EOD PST. For QPS we can propose autoscale up to dedicated pool + burst. Will confirm token-cost estimate.

marta (RevOps): Heads-up — legal prefers PO before launch. If Velux wants BYOK on first week of May we need PO signed by Apr 24. Can someone ping procurement?

james (AE): pinged Velux procurement earlier — they said procurement week of Apr 10. I’ll push for Apr 20.

julia (Sales Ops): thanks team. @miho please drop checklist link here when you have it. @oliver — can you attach diagram to this thread when ready? :thumbsup:

redwood-bot: document created — /drive/velux/security-questionnaire v1 uploaded by miho
